programme.title: Henry Danger: Gravalvorligt
programme.desc: Ray begynder at opføre sig mærkeligt, og da Henry og Charlotte undersøger, hvad der er galt, får de sig en overraskelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Voldkopper
programme.desc: Piper får en mystisk sygdom, så Kaptajn Mand må rejse tilbage til 1700-tallet, for at finde den eneste kur.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jeg Kender din Hemmelighed
programme.desc: Henry har fået en mystisk besked fra en, og er bekymret for om hans hemmelige identitet er blevet afsløret.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsnarreren
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand kæmper mod tidsnarreren, ryger Faredrengen uheldigvis ind i hans tidsmaskine og gennemlever derefter den samme dag om og om igen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Fiñata Fuld af Dødbringende Bier
programme.desc: Da en farlig piñata dukker op til en børnefødselsdag, må Faredreng og Kaptajn Mand gå under dække og træde til - inden det er for sent!

programme.title: Henry Danger: Bagværk med Bagtanker
programme.desc: Da Kaptajn Mand pludselig bekendtgør, at han skal giftes, begynder Henry og Charlotte at lede efter svar - kun for at opdage at tingene ikke er, som de ser ud til.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Skrigemaskinen
programme.desc: Charlottes opfindelse til Gizmo-showet ved et uheld bliver ødelagt og genskabt, og Charlotte er bekymret for, om al opmærksomheden hun får, kan afsløre Faredrengs og Kaptajn Mands hemmelige identiteter.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Frittlesproblemet
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand og Faredreng befinder sig midt i en diskussion om, hvad der skal være Swellviews nye yndlingschips. Superheltene må finde en måde at afholde deres personlige smagspræferencer fra at præge deres daglige arbejde.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Drive Thru Murder
programme.desc: Missy Berry is found dead in an idling car at a deserted intersection. A surprise twist in the investigation leads him into uncharted territory.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Into Thin Air
programme.desc: 24yr old Lorraine Laribo is dropped off at a bar by her sister's boyfriend. It's the last time anyone would ever see her alive again. Kenda must use his interrogation skills to find her killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Master Key
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother and her two young sons are brutally slain, pressure mounts for the CSPD to catch the cold-blooded monster who did it.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Nine-Year-Old Hostage
programme.desc: A hostage situation puts Sgt. Joe Kenda and his team to the test, as they try to save a family without getting shot themselves.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 104

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 105

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 106

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 201

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 202

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 809

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Episode 810

programme.desc: Kæmpemarsvin angriber byer rundt om på jorden. Drengene har nøglen til at redde menneskeheden, men de sidder fast i Andesbjergene

programme.desc: Kennys forældre bliver anholdt og han kommer i pleje - så nu er Cartman det fattigste barn på skolen! Og en mystisk, maskeret figur fra fortiden vender tilbage.

programme.title: Bense på tur: Lars Thiesgaard
programme.desc: Turen går til Nykøbing Falster, hvor vi møder Lars Thiesgaard – manden med de 1.000 stemmer. Han demonstrerer stemmeprøver fra blandt andet Pumba, Scooby-Doo og Grisling, og deler anekdoter fra sin lange og spændende karriere i sit job som skuespiller.

programme.title: Bense på tur: Lars Rasmussen
programme.desc: I Nordsjælland møder vi tidligere landsholdsspiller Lars Rasmussen, nu foredragsholder. Han fortæller om livet med autisme og ADHD, fra udfordringer til styrker, og tager os med til et sted, der betyder meget for ham.

programme.title: Bense på tur
programme.desc: Denne gang bytter vi roller: Mikkel Kryger stiller ikke, men svarer. Vi besøger en butik, der rummer hans passioner, og dykker ned i, hvordan tilfældigheder har formet ham til en af landets mest folkekære værter.

programme.title: Bense på tur: Roland Møller
programme.desc: Fra fynske rødder i hiphop- og kriminelt miljø til internationale film. Roland Møller fortæller om sin vej til skuespillet, sin kompromisløse tilgang og troen på egne evner.

programme.title: Bense på tur: Marie Watson
programme.desc: Marie Watson, anerkendt gamer og influencer, har vundet priser ved Danish Game Awards og medvirket i Forræder. På vores tur møder vi en ung følger fra chatten, nu til studenterfest — et førstegangsmøde IRL.

programme.title: Bense på tur: Wafande
programme.desc: Musikken har altid været hos Wafande, selvom drømmen engang var at blive næste Michael Jordan. Han deler barndomshistorier, sin lyst til at sprede glæde og et uventet besøg på en kirkegård i jagten på … spøgelser?

programme.title: Bense på tur
programme.desc: Vi tager endnu en tur med Linse Kessler, hvor snakken går om kiosklivet, fortiden som håndlanger og alt det, hun har oplevet siden sidst – med masser af grin og hygge undervejs.

programme.title: Bense på tur
programme.desc: Peter "dupreeh" Rasmussen er verdens mest vindende CS-spiller med fem Major-titler og rekorddeltagelse i alle Majors. Nu bosat i Aarhus fokuserer han på familielivet og nye muligheder efter CS Pro karrieren.

programme.title: Bense på tur: Rosa Hatting
programme.desc: Rosa Hatting, kendt fra Paradise Hotel for sin ukronede ærlighed, viser nu sit tætte bånd til sine grønlandske rødder og deler drømme og kampe med ordblindhed — mens vi kører gennem Glostrup og taler om nyt image.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Paprika Steen

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Caroline Fleming

programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Den Gode Gerning” er skudt i gang, og som noget nyt hylder Pelle og René folk, der til dagligt gør en forskel for andre. Det bliver virkelig rørende, da de hjælper brystkræftramte Malene med at sige tak til hendes hjælpsomme veninde Michelle.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 304
programme.desc: Pernille og Nicklas fra Odense bor så småt, at hvis man skal have lidt privatliv, er der kun toilettet at ty til. Nicklas drømmer om få et køkken med mange blus og to ovne, så han kan lave mere mad.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 305
programme.desc: Wendy og Jesper fra Kalundborg bor i forvejen godt i en lejlighed, der har en formidabel udsigt, men en kommende familieforøgelse gør, at de skal finde noget der er større.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 306
programme.desc: Jonas og Louise bliver rystede, da de ser hvilket hus de har råd til. Mads Mikkelsen og Tobias Edlev Nielsen er denne gang kommet på overarbejde for at prøve at imødekomme parrets ønsker.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 307
programme.desc: Mads og Mia vil gerne flytte udenfor byen – men ikke helt på landet. Med Tobias og Mads´ hjælp køber de en bolig, der har lige nøjagtig alt det, de ikke bryder sig om.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 101
programme.desc: Vært Lisbeth Østergaard og de to eksperter besøger Maiken og Michael i deres lille lejlighed, hvor de bor sammen med Michaels datter. Snart bliver de fire og kan ikke længere være i lejligheden.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 201
programme.desc: Ægteparret Claus og Kristina knokler 100 timer om ugen for at få Den lille havfrue til at løbe rundt. Men de har trods det ikke råd til at give sig selv løn, og nu er motivationen så småt ved at forsvinde.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 202

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 204
programme.desc: Dean har mere end 25 års erfaring fra det københavnske restaurationsmiljø, så alt tegnede lovende, da han for tre år siden åbnede Chantilly i hjertet af København.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 205
programme.desc: Antonino åbnede Da Vinci i Hadsund - og det er en succes, Bo Bechankommer til. Det er en helt ny og meget stor restaurant som tilbyder italiensk mad til borgerne i Hadsund stort set døgnet rundt. Og det er gået helt fantastisk.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 206
programme.desc: Brødrene Rene og Martin åbnede sidste år deres første restaurant i Jyllinge havn. Efter en lovende start kører stedet nu med underskud.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Dropping Like Flies

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Free Vinny

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Nothing But Nice
programme.desc: Vinny kommer tilbage, og alle fejrer. Mike prøver at være sød, men ender med at irritere fyrene. Snooki kæmper med en ubehagelig situation.

programme.desc: The Situation samler i al hemmelighed information, der skal fælde en af hans bofæller - og for en gangs skyld er det ikke Snooki. JWoww går ud af sit gode skind, idet Roger er forsvundet og ikke besvarer hendes opkald.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Love at the Jersey Shore
programme.desc: Alle bofællerne er optaget af hver deres flamme, men det betyder ikke, at der er fred i huset. Én af bofællerne ryger uklar med tøserne, mens Jennis lette påklædning irriterer Roger.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Sharp Objects
programme.desc: Gruppen forsøger at undgå et hajangreb på deres fisketur. Jenni konfronterer Paulys forfølger. Snooki begynder at fokusere på Vinny, da hendes kæreste afviser hendes tilnærmelser.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Duk og Kast-drengen
programme.desc: Da Henry bruger sin nye superkraft for at konkurrere i en Duk og Kast turnering, går Ray, Schwoz og Charlotte undercover for at give Henry en lærestreg.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Ruminvasion, Første del
programme.desc: Da Kaptajn-mand og Faredrengen opdager, at en astronaut fra Swellview er blevet taget som gidsel på Rumstationen, bruger de Schwoz' Kærlighedsskib til at blive affyret ud i rummet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Ruminvasion, Anden del
programme.desc: Ombord på Rumstationen opdager Kaptajn-mand og Faredrengen, at en lille pige står bag kidnapningen af astronauterne. Da de finder ud af, at astronauterne udfører forsøg på kaniner, beslutter de at hjælpe hende.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood On the Tracks
programme.desc: When an unsuspecting train conductor discovers a decapitated body on a lonely stretch of track, Lt. Joe Kenda must unravel the mystery of his death.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: City Of Fear
programme.desc: When a spate of violent robberies spreads terror across the city, Kenda and the major crimes unit are called in to bring the masked gunman to justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The End
programme.desc: Kenda faces his most difficult case yet – the slaying of a young boy. The detective makes the most consequential decision of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lockdown
programme.desc: When a crazed gunman terrorizes his neighborhood, officers put themselves in the line of fire to restore order.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sing Sing, Little Bird
programme.desc: A romantic rendezvous is cut short by a violent home invasion, leaving young business owner Kelly Knudson bleeding to death on the floor and Lt Joe Kenda is short on leads.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
programme.desc: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 2: Moons
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 5: Space Missions
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong
programme.desc: Neil Armstrong has stamped his place in History by becoming the first person to walk on the moon.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage
programme.desc: Interviews with Apollo 8 astronauts, their wives, mission control staff, and journalists give true insider's perspective to the space race of the late 1960's.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged

programme.desc: Med gæstekunstnere som Ane Brun, Kristofer Greczula og Veera Pyykkö indtager Mando Diao MTV Unplugged-scenen. Pluto TV byder på en intim koncert med Mando Diao og deres nye album "Efter Solnedgången"

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz MTV Unplugged

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.
